question: What is the purpose of the Earth's magnetic field?

options.text: To provide an energy source for life on Earth
To shield the Earth from solar wind and cosmic radiation
To cause the tides in the ocean

solution:
The correct answer is __**To shield the Earth from solar wind and cosmic radiation.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The purpose of the** Earth's magnetic field** is to shield the planet from **solar wind** and **cosmic radiation.**
 
• This is important because these particles can be harmful to **life on Earth** and can cause damage to our atmosphere.
 
• The Earth's magnetic field is generated by the movement of** molten iron** in the planet's core.
 
• This creates a **magnetic field **that extends out into space and protects the planet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Earth's magnetic field **does not** provide energy for life on Earth.
 
• While the Earth's magnetic field may have **some impact on the climate,** its primary purpose is to protect the planet from solar wind and cosmic radiation.
 
• The **tides** are primarily caused by the **gravitational pull **of the moon and the sun.
 
• The **magnetic field** that emanates from** Earth's interior **and interacts with the** solar wind,a stream of charged particles** that comes from the Sun, is called the geomagnetic field, or Earth's magnetic field.
